selector_policy: Exact part names; no aliases, category matching, renaming or wildcards. Preserve all 25 legacy targets. Expanded views require explicit candidate metadata; fail on missing selectors.

sources.supports: Connective hierarchy and supporting neurovascular locations.
Satellite cells underneath basal lamina; separate mononucleated cellular identity.
Sarcolemmal invagination, A–I positioning, triad and distinct SR calcium compartment.

Acetylcholine across cleft to postsynaptic receptors and basal-membrane acetylcholinesterase.
Capsule, intrafusal bag/chain fibers, sensory organization and surrounding extrafusal context.

states.scale_note: SCHEMATIC: separate axial and transverse enlargement; biological measurements are unavailable. Counts, spacing, membrane thickness and cuts are teaching samples.
states.caption: Follow the deliberately opened whole-muscle coat, fascicle boundaries, individual fibers and intracellular myofibril samples. A fiber is one cell; the exposed smaller myofibrils are not branching cells. Band samples retain the striation context. Fine nuclei, junction, spindle and excitation detail are deferred to named views. Seven fascicles and reduced fiber counts are representative; telescope stages use different enlargement.
states.limitations: This is an opening hierarchy view, not a simultaneous full anatomy inventory. New support-window tissue recipes and this reduced visibility have not been built or visually accepted. The nominal 3 mm original core cannot calibrate the telescope or enlarged cellular fields.
states.acceptance: With selection glow off, identify whole coat, larger fascicle boundary, smaller fiber profiles and banded myofibril samples. Fine excitation, spindle and nuclear markers must not dominate the opening. Saved-new-output framing remains deferred.
